description: This file defines the object 'OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction' which contains utility functions for extracting actions from user JSON objects, sanitizing strings for tags, formatting messages for the UI, and dispatching status events related to UI actions in an Android application.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction
classes.description: A singleton object providing utility functions for processing user actions related to the UI in an Android app.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts the action name or fallback to action field from a user action JSON object.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be used as a tag value by trimming, replacing spaces, and replacing invalid characters with underscores.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Constructs a formatted message string with action details and optional context JSON for UI communication.

methods.name: jsonStringLiteral
methods.description: Helper function to produce a JSON-compatible string literal with proper escaping.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript snippet that dispatches a custom event indicating the status of a UI action.
